comment:
Quote: "Of the 173 randomized participants, 15 did not attend the
baseline assessment due to work-related scheduling conflicts.
These absences were unrelated to the randomization
itself and were the result of workflow processes, not
individual volition. Due to these initial drop-outs,
a modified intention-to-treat (mITT) analysis was used"
